summary: Charge one-height chain multiplicity classes at separate meshes to obtain the target discrepancy within the cost budget.
Make append and finalization agree on ordering when direct queue additions and an entry's new items share one uncommitted turn.
Require reading the refusing tool's source before changing its input; the implemented gate awaits a review-backed closure.
Require Owed attempt claims to point to an actual heading or paragraph where the promised attempt was performed.
Require Smallest case and cost-bounded Nonvacuity witnesses to satisfy every class hypothesis at their actual parameters.
Check that a Shortest route marked Taken is actually attempted or proved, rather than replaced by a side result.
Before registering a conjecture, require composing recorded bounds on all its parts to see whether they already prove it.
Require quantitative evaluation of resembling claims on witnesses, not merely naming the claims with an unsupported verdict.
Extend refusal tracking to shell writes and renamed copies of a refused input, preserving legitimate independent commands.
Give refused runs their own output path and prevent newest-log lookups from presenting a previous run's output.
Require framework replay figures to distinguish complete counts from judged samples and state each sample's size.
Check next-attempt statements against recorded lower bounds, obstructions and exclusions found in the attempt's own object terms.
Stop dependent commands from using stale files when an earlier edit in the same tool-call batch was refused.
Check whether the on-curve Leighton–Shor class lower bound is dominated by the Lipschitz class lower bound and record the relation.
Correct coarse-sufficiency wording to distinguish the matching condition throughout its range from the conjecture on the curve.
Ask whether each bound-based open/empty/decided assessment needs an upper or lower bound, and whether its citation supplies that direction.
Before deferring a computational attempt, require reading applicable scripts' saved outputs or measuring the needed step.
Require an actual computation behind claims that a method fails, cannot work, or has too many cases.
Require the converse or counterexample asserted by relations such as strictly stronger, not equivalent, restatement and supersedes.
Check quantified ranges in summaries against the statement's actual parameter conditions.
Record launcher refusals and block relaunches just below a long-run threshold that still omit the required justification.
Profile and fix the notebook layout test's measured overrun under the suite's own parallel CPU load.
Require extension witnesses to beat the plainest composition of earlier results at their full allowed parameter ranges.
Evaluate an entry's defining quantities on its proposed next attempt before claiming the attempt remains open.
Require a proof step using each stated sign condition, distinguishing genuine sign dependence from absolute-value estimates.
Check blind-stage questions against a withheld list of route objects and rankings to prevent steering the reviewer.
Disambiguate sibling claims' record statements using labels or structure rather than unreliable summary-word overlap.
Test whether a good (4,4) matching implies coarse discrete sufficiency through a congestion or tube-density bound.
Label unverified mathematical uses of reviewer suggestions and prevent crediting reviewers with operations the author added.
Measure slow framework tools, especially the finisher, and investigate keeping prompt-cache benefits during long tool runs.
